Camera permission needed to scan QR code
1. Receiver taps \"Receive Content\" to start hotspot/advertising and show the QR code.
2. Sender taps \"Scan QR Code\" with the camera to scan the receiver\'s code.
3. Sender waits for the receiver: a confirmation dialog appears on the receiver: \"[Phone Name] wants to connect with you\".
4. Once accepted by the receiver, the devices pair securely and media can be transferred at high speed!
5. Transferred videos are saved in app storage and can be played offline anytime.
